remarks: Wonderful small complex located right on the Wilton line. Situated between Walmart shopping plaza and TJMax. Private entrance to the units at the end of the building with red door. Retail units on the ground level with great restaurant choices. Very spacious open layout with lots natural light, Living room has vaulted ceiling, skylight, large sliders to your own balcony, fully equipped kitchen with breakfast bar, stackable washer and dryer and good closets spaces. Upper floor has the primary bedroom, full bath, large open closet space with enough room for a desk if you need a work area. Large private storage room in the basement. Minutes to several shopping choices, gym, medical facilities, major roads plus Merritt 7 train station. Make this fabulous unit your own with your own personal touches.
